# Only a string enum is a declaration: an enum of integers is left out.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl check app.sngl
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": field level of Thing is left out: an enum of integer, and only a string enum is a declaration'
stderr 'app.sngl:8:14: no field'

-- app.sngl --
import api "openapi:./api.yml"

func idOf(c api.Thing) int {
    return c.id
}

func gone(c api.Thing) {
    var x = c.level
}
-- api.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
servers:
- url: https://api.example
paths:
  /thing:
    get:
      operationId: getThing
      responses:
        '200': {description: '', content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Thing'}}}}
components:
  schemas:
    Thing:
      type: object
      required: [id]
      properties:
        id: {type: integer}
        level: {type: integer, enum: [1, 2]}
